disorder-name.detail: Mild cognitive impairment; diagnosed subjects from the NIMHANS cohort to whom the DNT normative model was applied at inference time.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "The dataset consists of neuroimaging data from 123 cognitively normal participants (CN), 89 diagnosed with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and 90 with AD."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Single-site clinical cohort acquired at the National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences, Bengaluru, India. Data collected on two 3T scanners (Philips Ingenia and Siemens Skyra).
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We analyzed 3T diffusion MRI (dMRI) data in a sample of 302 participants from two scanners from the NIMHANS (National Institute of Mental Health and Neuro Sciences) cohort (see Table I) in India."

age.detail: Age is not reported separately for the MCI group. The paper provides age only for the full NIMHANS cohort stratified by scanner: Philips Ingenia (N=110): mean 67.67 ± 7.13 years; Siemens Skyra (N=192): mean 67.02 ± 8.26 years; Total (N=302, CN+MCI+AD): mean 67.26 ± 7.86 years. MCI-specific age cannot be derived from the available data.

sex.detail: Sex is not reported separately for the MCI group. The paper provides sex only for the full NIMHANS cohort stratified by scanner: Philips Ingenia (N=110): M=66/F=44; Siemens Skyra (N=192): M=116/F=76 (note: the PDF text reads '116/81' which sums to 197≠192; F=76 is inferred from 192−116); Total (N=302, CN+MCI+AD): M=177/F=125. MCI-specific sex breakdown cannot be derived from the available data.
